slides.heading: The problem
bullets: A stack with O(1) push, pop, peek, getMin and getMax by storing the running min/max alongside each element.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. A stack with constant push, pop, peek, getMin and getMax by storing the running min or max alongside each element.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Store the current min and max alongside each pushed value so they're always available.
